description: Defines the WorkflowExecutionContext class which manages the execution state and control flow of a workflow, including activity tracking, cancellation, fault handling, and transition path analysis.

classes.name: WorkflowExecutionContext
classes.description: Manages the context and execution state of a workflow, including input/output properties, activity tracking, cancellation, fault handling, and transition path analysis.

methods.name: WorkflowExecutionContext
methods.description: Constructor initializing the workflow execution context with provided workflow data and activities.

methods.name: GetActivity
methods.description: Retrieves the activity context for a given activity ID.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the cancellation token source.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels the workflow execution and sets its status to aborted.

methods.name: Fault
methods.description: Marks the workflow as faulted and records the exception message.

methods.name: GetInboundTransitions
methods.description: Returns inbound transitions for a specified activity.

methods.name: GetOutboundTransitions
methods.description: Returns outbound transitions for a specified activity.

methods.name: GetInboundActivityPath
methods.description: Returns the full path of inbound activities leading to a specified activity.

methods.name: GetInboundActivityPathInternal
methods.description: Recursive helper to determine inbound activity path, with cycle detection.
